'''Dayja''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] for [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He worked with [[d'Ashewl]] to spy on the [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]], and with the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in his disguise as the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Eanjer Kunarazti]] to finish his mission to hunt a [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Qazadi]].<ref name="Scoundrels" />
